title: Identifying HTML Tags and Attributes
instructions: Given a small HTML snippet, identify the tag and the attribute name needed to extract the specific value.
steps: Identify the tag that contains the text 'Download Now'.
Identify the attribute on that tag that holds the link URL.
Assign the identified tag name to the `link_tag` variable (as a string).
Assign the identified attribute name to the `url_attribute` variable (as a string).
starterCode:
# HTML Snippet: #
#

Welcome

# Download Now #
# Your task is to extract the link URL. link_tag = ... url_attribute = ... print(f"Tag to target: {link_tag}") print(f"Attribute to read: {url_attribute}")
solution:
# HTML Snippet: #
#

Welcome

# Download Now #
# Your task is to extract the link URL. link_tag = 'a' url_attribute = 'href' print(f"Tag to target: {link_tag}") print(f"Attribute to read: {url_attribute}")
hints: The anchor tag `<a>` is used for links.
The attribute that specifies the destination URL of a link is `href`.
